Excellent: Scope of analysis is very well articulated, with purpose of analysis and importance of research questions clearly described.
Good: Scope of analysis is well articulated, but may require minor revisions to clarify the purpose of analysis and/or importance of research questions.
Adequate: Scope of analysis is less well articulated, and may require substantial revisions to clarify the purpose of analysis or importance of research questions.
Poor: Written explanation is brief or incomplete, and questions are missing or inadequate.

Excellent: Clear and concise description of data wrangling and methods used for analysis.
Good: Relatively clear description of data wrangling and methods used, but provides too much or too little detail about particular components.
Adequate: Description of data wrangling or methods is inadequate.
Poor: Little to no description of data wrangling or methods provided.

Excellent: Results are clearly and completely summarized.
Good: Results are completely summarized, but description could be improved somewhat.
Adequate: Description of results is present but incomplete.
Poor: Written summary of results is very brief or missing.

Excellent: Implications of analysis and appropriate limitations are clearly stated.
Good: Some implications are limitations are stated.
Adequate: Conclusions are not appropriate and discussion of limitations is brief or missing.
Poor: Results are not summarized and conclusion is missing.

Excellent: Contents are very well organized under the appropriate section and subsection headings.
Good: Contents are organized under the appropriate section and subsection headings.
Adequate: Contents are somewhat organized under section and subsection headings.
Poor: Contents are poorly organized under section and subsection headings.

Good: Few errors in spelling, punctuation, and/or grammar. Mostly clear and understandable.
Adequate: Partly unclear, but mostly understandable. Several errors in spelling, punctuation, and/or grammar.
Poor: Too many errors in spelling, punctuation, and/or grammar, which make it unclear and difficult to follow.
